authority: Explicit user confirmation on 2026-10-27: add six distinct Mythicals, newly recorded stat names/values supersede old data, all 22 cost 1000 tokens; Leonidas effect is +1 Spartan unit. Subsequent explicit confirmations: Arm Reliquary Transport Cooldown -11%; Gemini 8 Helmet starts with Factory Troop Damage; T-34 Tank Engine starts with Invading Barracks Troop Damage; six new percentage perk sets and corrected Maori perk upgrade one magnitude point per level (+9 total); Norden effect deploys one Marine. Additional user-provided limited-time Mythicals: Elephant Archer Quiver (War), Fengguan Phoenix Crown (Main), Admiral Yi Helmet (Main); repeated perks retained. User subsequently clarified Fengguan row 2 All Defensive Towers Damage is +11%; all 18 canonicalized names and base values match existing entries. Profile 4: user requested reconciliation of all collected 300-token War Legendaries and their scanned artwork; reviewed level-1 scan text is the source for the selected five-perk sets (not independent pixel verification).
